items.topic: FOMC decision 2026-10-28: hold at 3.75%-4.00%, 10-2 vote, two hawkish dissents
items.facts: The FOMC held its target range at 3.75%-4.00% on Wednesday 10-28, a 10-2 vote. Governors Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissented, preferring a 25bp hike. The statement kept 'inflation remains elevated' language while upgrading its assessment of economic activity to a 'strong' pace. Chair Kevin Warsh's 2:30pm press conference said the Fed will reduce the number of rate-setting meetings starting in 2027 and reiterated he does not favor forward guidance absent a crisis. TD Economics reads the pause as raising the odds of a December hike; Seeking Alpha likewise reports markets pricing one more 25bp hike in December.
items.caveat: This is the test condition for claims-ledger entry CL-0052 (opened 10-27): the vote split and growth-language upgrade point toward the policy-driven branch, but the Treasury/SOFR legs of that specific test are mixed as of today's data and the claim's deadline (Fri 10-30) hasn't arrived -- reported as progress, not resolved.

items.topic: Vertiv (VRT) +16.48% on Q3 beat, order growth, raised guidance
items.facts: Vertiv's Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $2.21 beat the ~$1.82 consensus; net sales of $4.31B beat the ~$3.75B estimate, up 61% YoY. Organic orders grew more than 100% YoY. Management raised full-year guidance and guided Q4 adjusted EPS to $2.22-$2.28, above the $2.21 consensus. Executive Chairman Dave Cote tied the beat to accelerating AI/data-center infrastructure demand. Vertiv led S&P 500 gainers on the day; this system's own close ($242.94 from $208.56, +16.48%) matches.
items.caveat: Sources differ slightly on the exact intraday magnitude (13%-16.5%, depending on snapshot); this system's own script-verified close is used for magnitude per §4C.

items.topic: Oracle (ORCL) +10.73% on investor-day long-term targets, not a new earnings print
items.facts: At an investor day, Oracle set a timeline back to positive free cash flow in the second half of fiscal 2028, a free-cash-flow target of $30B+ by fiscal 2029, a long-term revenue target of at least $225B by fiscal 2030, and capped new capital raises through fiscal 2030. Oracle reaffirmed fiscal 2027 guidance (at least $90B revenue, $8.10 non-GAAP EPS). The stock was roughly flat near $130 until about 2:20pm ET, then jumped ~13% within minutes of the release; this system's own close ($144.54 from $130.53, +10.73%) matches the most commonly reported figure. Volume ran roughly 2.7x its recent average.
items.caveat: A few sources report slightly higher closes ($147.06-$147.43); this system's own script-verified close is used per §4C.

items.topic: F5 (FFIV) -20.43% despite a Q4 beat, on tepid FY2027 growth guidance
items.facts: F5's fiscal Q4 2026 revenue rose 13% YoY to $917M, topping the ~$884M consensus. The stock fell on guidance: FY2027 implies 8-9% revenue growth, down from 11% in FY2026; EPS guidance for next quarter slightly missed; operating margin fell to 23.1% from 25.4% a year earlier. Analysts cited a decelerating hardware-refresh cycle and uncertainty about how quickly new AI-enabled products translate into revenue. Piper Sandler downgraded the stock to Neutral; RBC and Morgan Stanley raised price targets despite the move. F5 also authorized a $1.5B share-repurchase program.
items.caveat: Sources report the regular-session close at approximately -20.4%, matching this system's own scan (-20.43%).
